feed.h: Prosecutors add bribery and honest-services fraud counts against Terry Rozier in NBA betting case
feed.b: A superseding indictment made public May 28 adds two counts against the former NBA guard, bringing the total to four, including honest-services wire fraud conspiracy. It alleges he agreed to leave a March 2023 game early for a payment of about $100,000 and received about $70,000. It adds no new games. Rozier is charged and has pleaded not guilty to the original counts; his lawyer called the new charges a misplaced effort. (Late catch added Oct. 5.)

src.t: Feds Say Terry Rozier Took $70K Bribe in Sports Betting Case
Prosecutors plan to file new charges against Terry Rozier

feed.h: Sports bettor Marves Fairley pleads guilty in NBA betting case, saying he paid a player to change performance
feed.b: Fairley changed his plea to guilty on one count of wire fraud conspiracy and one count of money laundering conspiracy, according to Front Office Sports, and said he agreed to pay a player to alter performance. Prosecutors say the player was Rozier, who is charged and has pleaded not guilty. Fairley is the second defendant to plead guilty in the case after Damon Jones. (Late catch added Oct. 5.)

feed.h: Sports betting is now the main problem in more than a quarter of national helpline contacts
feed.b: Sports betting was the primary gambling type in 27.3% of 2025 helpline conversations, up from 22.3% in 2024.

src.t: National Problem Gambling Helpline 2025 Annual Report

feed.h: Rhode Island attorney general sues Kalshi and Polymarket over sports event contracts
feed.b: Attorney General Peter Neronha filed suit in Rhode Island Superior Court asking for a declaration that the platforms' sports event contracts are sports betting under state law. The complaint, which is an allegation, also seeks an injunction plus restitution and disgorgement. The office says sports betting has brought the state $2.8 billion since 2019 and that lottery-run bets fell 8% from 2024 to 2025.

src.t: Attorney General Neronha sues Kalshi and Polymarket for unlawfully conducting sports gambling in Rhode Island
